sections.section_title: MDF digital filter data register x (MDF_DFLTxDR)
sections.text_helper: Section 35.8.20 "MDF digital filter data register x (MDF_DFLTxDR)" in chapter 35 (Multi-function digital filter (MDF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1705.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0F0 + 0x80 * x, (x = 0 to 5)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register is used to read the data processed by each digital filter. The number of
registers is equal to the amount of filters. Refer to Section35.3 for details.
Bits 31:8 DR[23:0]: Data processed by digital filter
Bits 7:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
